currentJournalGoal.objective:
Polis UI/UX overhaul — apply the issues visible in the user's screenshots to the whole project, not just the two surfaces shown. Scope:

(1) MAIN MENU DEDUP. The Main Menu currently has TWO continue buttons ("Continue Your Polis" large, "Continue Your City" small). Both lead to the same game-resume path. Remove the smaller button so the menu has exactly one continue button.

(2) BUILD DASHBOARD REDESIGN. The Build Dashboard currently shows 8 columns of tiny cards and a right-side "Select a Building" description panel that displays a "?" placeholder when nothing is selected. Redesign: drop the right panel entirely; use 6 cards/row at standard widths and 7 at narrow windows; each card uses the building's hero illustration as the card background, with name + cost + hotkey overlaid in a footer strip. Hover/select state shows the full description in a footer bar across the bottom of the dashboard (not a side panel). The keyboard-navigation order must remain canonical (left-to-right, top-to-bottom).

(3) MINIMAP DEFAULT OFF. The in-game minimap occupies ~22% of the top-right viewport and is reportedly "static / waste of space" on a static map. Add a `Show Minimap` toggle to the Settings panel; default the toggle to OFF on first boot (existing players keep their current setting; new players get OFF). When OFF, the minimap is hidden and its layout space reflows so the HUD does not collapse awkwardly.

(4) MENU AUDIT. Survey Settings, StatsScreen, PauseModal, and Inspector for the same class of issues (wasted space, redundant controls, dead panels, layout collisions, dead buttons). Append each finding to .pi-glla/audit-loop/findings.md (append-only; the existing audit-ledger guard is the source of truth). Do NOT fix the findings in this goal — they are queued as follow-up list items.

(5) AGNES ASSET PIPELINE. Generate 1K (1024×1024) hero-quality building illustrations via Agnes for every building entry currently in the catalogue (~50 buildings across Infra/Housing/Industry/Civic/Religion categories). Replace the current low-res tiles wholesale. Use the existing art/ directory layout. Verify the build still renders (no broken paths, no missing-asset console errors). Do NOT add a new art style guide in this goal — match whatever style is currently shipped, just at higher resolution. Style-guide development is its own later goal if desired.

(6) PER-ERA MUSIC. Wire a TRACKS list keyed by era (Foundation, Classical, etc.) into era-of-polis.ts; era-music-player.ts picks the track for the current era on era transition. Same architecture as the existing ambient-loop single-track path, just with N tracks. Source the audio files from existing shipped assets or a placeholder; the wiring is the deliverable, not the music itself (a follow-up goal can replace the placeholder tracks with Agnes-generated audio).

OUT OF SCOPE: game logic changes, mobile support, server features, other games, complete art style overhaul, music composition.

Single-trunk linear execution on main. Auto-commit daemon owns the commit; do not hand-commit. Append-only audit ledger guard is enforced — every change to findings.md must pass `python3 .../web/scripts/lib/guard-append-only.py --file .pi-glla/audit-loop/findings.md` exit 0.
